items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah, for Everything Must Change, right. But, If I Ever Lose this Heaven, oh man. Al Jarreau doing all his vocal percussion. This one for, again, my generation, was another one of those that just looms large in our formation. Then back to Esther Phillips, Performance, CTI, small – oh, it’s got strings. Richard Tee, Pepper Adams, yourself.
Then the next one, Bill Evans, Symbiosis, with Claus Ogerman orchestra. Again, you’re a section player.
